name: Already Know The Game - the address you do not own yet

sequence.note: Part of the four-campaign flood. Distinct from cost-is-not-the-reason: that campaign answers the price objection; this one answers a competence objection that was never true. Own palette (shutter), own plates, own blog set. No shared media.

business_goal: Reach operators who already run a working business on informal infrastructure and show that the formal layer - a domain, a page, a way to be reached - is administrative work they have not done, not a skill they lack.
positioning_line: You already run a business. You just do not own the address it runs on.

audience.label: NOT NAMED IN ANY PUBLISHED COPY. Held here as production context only.
audience.description: Someone with real commercial instinct - pricing, margin, demand, reputation, repeat custom, collecting money - learned by running something rather than by studying it. Formalising the operation is in progress or wanted.
audience.what_they_do_not_need: To be taught how to sell, to be encouraged, or to be told they are behind.
audience.what_they_do_need: A plain description of the administrative layer: a domain, a public page, a way to take a request, something that survives a platform decision.

tone_contract.address_the_skill_never_the_past: Copy speaks only to present capability. No reference, direct or coded, to any history, circumstance, institution, or 'second chance'. No redemption arc, because nothing here needs redeeming.
tone_contract.never_name_the_audience: No drop names, hints at, or bounds who this is for. Every line must read as a message to any self-taught operator. A reader outside the intended audience should notice nothing.
tone_contract.respect_never_pity: The reader is competent and is being told something practical. No uplift, no encouragement, no congratulation.
tone_contract.verification: Every headline, body line and caption in this campaign was read against these four rules before it was rendered. See README.md, 'Tone audit'.

primary_offer.scope: ONE focused landing-page website + ONE year of FAMtastic-managed hosting + first-year registration of a new domain when needed, or connection of a domain the customer already owns.
explicitly_not_included: Business email on the customer domain (FAM-BUSINESS-EMAIL, separate $99 one-time)

creative_direction.palette_argument: Cold rolled steel and grey concrete #16181A is what this business physically stands on and in front of. Weathered stencil yellow #E4C227 is the colour system already installed on every street where commerce happens - loading-bay paint, curb markings, shutter warning stripes, hand-lettered price boards - after a few winters have bleached it chalky. Nothing in the palette is new to the reader, which is the campaign's whole claim.
creative_direction.anchor_divergence: DELIBERATE, and measured rather than estimated. Ground swatch luminance 24/255; all 18 finished frames measured at mean luminance 51.4 (range 40.7-60.8) against the 150-175 band from the premium HeyGen anchor (marketing/creative/heygen/reference-tokens.json). Accent coverage measures 2.03% of frame on average (range 0.12%-6.82%; drop-02's comparison slab is the 6.8% outlier) against the anchor's 1-2%. These frames are NOT anchor-graded and must never be cut in beside take-a. Full record and the reproduction command are in the campaign README.
creative_direction.look: grunge - high contrast, textured, worn; concrete, steel roller shutters, weathered paint, xerox halftone, torn paste-up edges
creative_direction.type_rule: All type set in Photoshop. Zero generated lettering in any plate.

plates.argues: The building is yours; the address on the concrete belongs to the block.
Atmosphere. The comparison geometry carries the argument.
The board exists, the paint exists, the price is written nowhere a stranger can read it.
Atmosphere. The working surface the checklist sits on.
Layer on layer of paste-up torn down to staples, and one clean rectangle where something was pulled off whole.
Atmosphere. The desk the paperwork happens on.
Not an argument. SOFT_LIGHT tooth over every frame.

channels.exclusion_reason: Plan hard constraint: YouTube's OAuth token is expired and TikTok is not approved for public posting; both need the owner. X and LinkedIn are out of scope for this lane. Queueing to a broken channel manufactures a failure.

spend_detail: 9 Gemini Flash Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image) generations at the published $0.0336 per 1K image: 7 first-pass plus 2 regenerations of akg-01 and akg-06 after generated letterforms were spotted by eye. Ceiling for this campaign was $1.50. Photoshop composition, the palette, the compositor and all 18 stills cost $0.00 - they run on the existing Adobe subscription. generation-receipt.json reports $0.2352 because it merges results by id and so counts each plate once; $0.3024 is the true billable count.
